budget.selection: earliest best validation MAE for A1; earliest best class-macro MRR for B1

BASE01.protein_stems: separate peptide/target learned LayerNorm640, Linear640->128, GELU
BASE01.pooling: peptide attention queried by full-target residue mean+context; target attention queried by peptide residue mean+context; masked softmax covers all concatenated residues
BASE01.context: 148 features: train-fitted temperature/pH values, six missing/verified indicators, case-normalized 12 chemical-state onehots, fixed128bin SHA256 character-trigram encoding of allowed chemical/assay/buffer/sequence-role inputs
BASE01.head: concat peptide128,target128,elementwise product128,absolute difference128,context64,2loglengths ->256 GELU dropout.1 ->1
BASE01.loss: training-only pKD zscore MSE; inverse transform for validation/test

MEANPOOL.same_as_BASE01_except: replace both attention pools with full masked residue means; same stems/context/head; attention-query parameters absent

BASE02.text: frozen Qwen full rule-free description maskedmean1536 -> learnedLayerNorm1536 Linear1536->256 GELU dropout.1
BASE02.pooling: normalized description-conditioned masked attention over every residue; normalize weighted residue pool and score against normalized description projection
BASE02.loss: uniform positive-normalized CE over train-class candidate universe only; all documented positives of identical train local sequences are merged; held-out class labels never enter training
BASE02.evaluation: all31 anonymized candidates; classmacroMRR on one query per exact local sequence with union documented positives; source members preserved

MEANALIGN.same_as_BASE02_except: description-independent masked mean of projected sequence residues; same projection/text/temperature parameters

backbones.protein_chunking: nonoverlap contiguous<=1022residues, concat, fullcoverage, BOS/EOS removed eachchunk; no crosschunk attention

inputs_explicitly_excluded: gold pkd/known positives outside training loss
